value.title: Spirit
value.synopsis: The New United Nations were formed 14 years later to pursue peace on the ruined lands.

value.title: Traitor
value.synopsis: Teen's escape would be delayed and is trapped by the New United Nations.

value.title: Dhola Vira
value.synopsis: Ulysses is forced to escort Teshio but is hindered by the vortex Dhola Vira.

value.title: Share
value.synopsis: Keel and Isla begin their life on the Ulysses.

value.title: Attack
value.synopsis: Captain Gould makes his move toward Wei and Tengel, threatening to launch nuclear missiles from the Ulysses.

value.title: K2
value.synopsis: Teen sees a map of the new world. But it includes precious information that may lead to further conflicts.

value.title: Praying
value.synopsis: In order to evade the pursuit from the New U.N. forces, the Ulysses enters the Dohla Vira again.

value.title: Reunite
value.synopsis: In order to reunite with Gould and his Ulysses crew, Keel, Josie and Teen manage to stow away on a floating dock that departs from Tibet.

value.title: The Globe
value.synopsis: As he is about to face execution, Keel must gamble for his life with the dock’s captain; the same captain who once caught him cheating.

value.title: Separattion
value.synopsis: Keel, Teen, and Josie managed to bypass the attack of the new UN Forces leading to the dock of the ULYSSES.

value.title: Battle of Metasequoia
value.synopsis: Having defeated the silent submarine from Wei Nation, the Ulysses finds itself at the sea of Metasaquoia engaged in the ultimate confrontation.

value.title: Blue
value.synopsis: Keel and Teen come to the conclusion that the only way to produce a long-lasting peace is to share their father's map with the entire world.
